name: The sessions list follows the live session
prose: the Sessions list is asked for again when a turn starts, again at the turn's first model output — the first message is what puts a session on disk, and with the clarify round on it is written only after that round — and when it ends, by the tab the turn belongs to, so the live session is listed during its first turn and a background tab's list is its own.
invariant: A session appears in its own tab's Sessions list as soon as its first turn starts, and the list is refreshed when a turn ends.
